title: LiuyeChatEvent
description: Liuye 5-protocol member · SSE envelope for Liuye BFF → frontend (v3 spec §2.1). 11 event types · permission.request added per PM 2026-05-11 ratify (control-layer explicit · NOT borrowed from tool.progress.payload). heartbeat 15s/30s · reconnect rules: seq gap < 10 and disconnect < 30s → Last-Event-ID resume · else full snapshot pull.

schema_version.description: Liuye contract schema version · fixed '1' for the current spec lock.

event.description: 11 SSE event types (v3 §2.1 verbatim · PM 2026-05-11 ratify permission.request as 11th · control-layer explicit). heartbeat = 15s tick · client treats dead after 30s silence.

turn_id.description: Conversation turn identifier · same across all events within one user turn. Managed handoff = new turn_id with parent_turn_id link (P0-8 R9).

message_id.description: Optional · set on message.created / turn.completed where a chat message is associated.

tool_call_id.description: Optional · set on tool.* / artifact.patch / evidence.attached / permission.request events when bound to a ToolCall.

artifact_id.description: Optional · set on artifact.patch / evidence.attached / tool.completed events when bound to an Artifact.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier · spans across BFF + 6 backend agents + LLM caller audit log. Required on every event for cross-system correlation.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number within a turn_id · client uses for gap detection (seq gap < 10 + disconnect < 30s → Last-Event-ID resume · else full snapshot pull). v3 §2.1 SSE hardline.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC event emit timestamp · matches Python datetime.isoformat() and JS toISOString().

payload.description: Event-specific payload. oneOf narrowing per event below · open for event types whose payload schema is still under iteration (P0/P1 followup). Critical payloads (TurnErrorPayload + PermissionRequestEventPayload) are fully specified in $defs.

oneOf.description: turn.error event · payload must conform to TurnErrorPayload (v3 §2.1 line 56-67 verbatim).
permission.request event · payload must conform to PermissionRequestEventPayload (v3 §2.1 line 69-82 verbatim · PM 2026-05-11 ratify · control-layer explicit · NOT via SSE v1 adapter).

All other 9 event types · payload narrowing left for follow-up schema iteration (artifact.patch payload = ArtifactPatch · evidence.attached payload = EvidenceRef · tool.progress payload = ProgressMessage). Schema kept open here to avoid premature lock before W1 D2+ fixture work.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. 'LLM_RATE_LIMIT' · 'TOOL_TIMEOUT' · 'PIPL_BLOCKED'). Stable across versions for telemetry grouping.

message.description: Internal/log message · English · for ops + trace correlation. NOT shown to RM directly.

retryable.description: Whether the same turn can be safely retried (idempotent). false = user must change input or wait for ops fix.

human_hint.description: 中文 RM-facing hint (e.g. '系统繁忙 · 30 秒后自动重试'). What the customer-manager sees in error banner. PII redaction MUST be applied before write.

trace_id.description: Echoed from envelope · enables RM to share trace_id with support for diagnosis.

tool_call_id.description: Optional · set when error originates from a specific ToolCall (not turn-level).

seq.description: Echoed from envelope · the seq at which error occurred.

retry_after_ms.description: Optional · suggested client retry delay in milliseconds (e.g. rate-limit backoff).

fallback_available.description: Optional · whether a degraded fallback path is available (e.g. PIPL block → use cn provider chain).

request_id.description: Same as PermissionRequest.id · stable identifier for this permission decision (idempotent across resends).

risk_tier.description: 3-tier risk classification · drives UI form factor: low=inline confirm · medium=modal · high=drawer with reason input. PM 2026-05-11 ratify.

action.description: Action identifier (e.g. 'credit_decision_submit' / 'ledger_write' / 'pipl_overseas_call'). Backend canonical id · not display label.

idempotency_key.description: Required on all irreversible actions · prevents double-execution if user double-clicks grant. Backend MUST dedupe on this key.

required_persona.description: Optional · RBAC required persona list (e.g. ['credit_officer', 'compliance_officer']). Backend-driven · frontend MUST NOT hardcode role names.

disabled_reason.description: Optional · when current persona lacks required role · UI shows greyed-out button with explicit reason text. Example: '需要合规官签字 · 当前角色无权限'.

reason_required.description: Optional · high-risk drawer requires user to type a reason before grant button enables. Default false for low/medium · typically true for high.

rule_source.description: Optional · audit trace · which policy emitted this request (e.g. 'policy.rbac' / 'policy.ledger_write' / 'policy.pipl'). Surfaces in decision_ledger for compliance review.

scope.description: Optional · grant scope. once = single action · session = current session · always = persistent until revoked. UI MUST default to 'once' for high-risk.

explanation.description: Optional · human-readable 中文 explanation shown in confirmation UI (e.g. '此操作将向决策账本写入授信决定 · 5 年留档 · 受银保监审计').

consequences.description: Optional · enumerated consequences (e.g. ['不可逆 · 写入 decision_ledger', '触发 PermissionRequest 全链路审计', '5 年留档']). UI bullet-list in high-risk drawer.
